_about: Invetra (231099, hero_mechanic): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: King Johnson, Nate, Renoir, Zantetsu, PBC, the Hero Development Division, PBC Hero Gadget No. 169, Metal Maniac Paradigm, Organics (ナチュア), Qualia City. Own romanizations: Luvetra (ルヴェトラ), Megatro Techno, Qualia TechCon, Murasame Mk3, Kingfisher Device. クール is kept as "cool" (his catchword).
profile: The PBC Hero Development Division's exclusive mechanic. With eccentric ideas and solid mech-building skills, he churns out one super gadget after another for the heroes, though his fixation on details is his one flaw.
titleCondition: Level Invetra to 100 and obtain his Amity Scroll

speech.home/atarashisobiga: If you need new equipment, leave it to me. I'll whip up a gadget that's extra cool and marvelous!
speech.home/aaa_kami: Aaah, divine inspiration just struck! W-wait, don't talk to me! Notes, notes! I have to write this down before I forget!
speech.home/yusha_maho: Heroes... magic... beastfolk... mechfolk... Other worlds have way too much going on! Aaah, ideas I want to build keep pouring out-- I'm thrilled, but where do I even start!?
speech.home/oo_korega: Ooh, so this is Shibuya manga...! I'm getting vibes that connect with Qualia City's comic culture. --Where's the next volume?
speech.home/fufufu_jumbiwa: Heh heh heh... All prepared, Mister Zantetsu? Then let's go, on a pilgrimage to the sacred sites of Metal Maniac Paradigm!
speech.home/saikowa_hitono: There are as many "bests" as there are people. That's exactly why you have to believe that what you love is the coolest. ...Right?
speech.ally/join: Invetra, PBC Hero Development Division, Development Section. Creator of the coolest gadgets in the world. Nice to meet you.
speech.ally/evolution: Friendship, trust, bonds between comrades... Heh, I thought those had nothing to do with me, since all I'm good at is building gadgets. I'm counting on you from here on out.

1.title: Hero Mechanic
1.summary: Through King Johnson's arrangements, Alk and the others meet Invetra, a developer of hero gadgets. To give some inspiration to Invetra, who is still learning and keeps making inventions that put romance above all else, Alk and the others show him to Starview Village.

lines.5: Oh, come on, this is crazy...!
lines.9: Having a hard time, boys and girls?
lines.14: Isn't it obvious!? Save the small talk for later, would you?
lines.18: How cold. And here I went to the trouble of arranging a secret weapon to break this deadlock.
lines.27: I'm Invetra, from the PBC Hero Development Division's Development Lab. I'm here for backup.
lines.31: N-nice to meet you...? Um, Development Lab?
lines.35: I develop hero gadgets. Like this one.
lines.38: Optical electromagnetic blade, Murasame Mk3. Theoretically infinite range. --Perfect for you, wouldn't you say?
lines.47: ......Awesome. This is awesome! This is so awesome!! Invetra!
lines.51: Heh, I'm honored by the praise. ...Only, I'm sorry.
lines.57: If you use it at its current max output, it explodes! Hahahaha!
lines.70: Well, it exploded, but I got some great data! I should put a bit more budget into the frame after all, or rather--
lines.74: ...So he's the same kind of person as Renoir and the others...?
lines.80: Well, he does make finicky stuff, but in a way he's even worse...
lines.85: Worse? How rude. Finickiness is romance. In other words, cool! Isn't it?
lines.88: Do you know Metal Maniac Paradigm? It's a hero anime where an Organic wears a bike that turns into an exoskeleton and fights crime.
lines.93: The original came out almost twenty years ago but it still has tons of die-hard fans and my analysis is that the romance of the in-universe gadgets--
lines.98: Ugh... Too fast and too close... Y-you turned what you love into your job, huh...?
lines.102: Anyway. I believe the most important thing for a hero is romance. And that gadgets are what bring it to life.
lines.105: Take this, for example! Shape-memory alloy armor that transforms to suit the situation!
lines.109: With Ms. Nate's cybernetic body specs it'd just get in the way, but this one suit handles land and air! Contaminated zones too!
lines.116: You said it transforms... Don't tell me this thing--
lines.120: Naturally, it uses a separate cartridge for each form.
lines.124: Cartridges...! I see...! The kind that makes sounds!
lines.128: I mean, wouldn't that be a hassle in real life...? If you lose one, you can't transform.
lines.133: You don't get it~. Keeping the cartridges separate has the advantage of making new features easy to add.
lines.137: --Most of all! It's fun when it gets turned into a toy!!
lines.147: Look at this too! Beat Nunchaku, whose attack rises the more you hit in time with the rhythm!
lines.151: How does that even work!? Is it a rhythm game!?
lines.155: And this, look! The Strike Back Suit, which only unleashes its finisher when you're on the verge of death!
lines.159: That's romance...! But wait, isn't that way too impractical...? You'll die...?
lines.163: Huh, but... I-it's cool, right? A comeback from a pinch is a classic, you know?
lines.168: See? He overdoes it. Listen to the people in the field for once.
lines.173: Ngh... Well, I admit there's room for improvement. I'm still in training, after all.
lines.176: That's exactly why, Mister Alk, I wanted to meet you, a walking bundle of inspiration. Today is a good day.
lines.181: Uh, thanks. W-whether I'll use any of it is a separate question, okay...?
lines.191: Ugh, this feels like déjà vu...
lines.195: Indeed! Your sharp intuition is a great help! Alk, may I rely on you again this time?
lines.198: --Inspiration for his inventions. Would you help him hone it?
lines.205: Ohhh... So this is the otherworldly secret base! I knew PBC had something going on, but never... like this...!
lines.209: Well... it's not just PBC, though. Think it'll give you ideas for inventions?
lines.214: Of course! Thank you, Alk! I feel like I can crank out amazing gadgets and hobby toys one after another!!
lines.218: Alright, let's do this...! I'll fill the world with our cool...!!

2.title: Highway Chase
2.summary: Invetra keeps inventing to prove the dream he shared with his brother, but a reckless biker calls his invention a child's toy. Seeing himself objectively for a moment brings Invetra back to his senses, and after reaffirming his roots, he challenges the biker once again.

lines.5: UI, designs, and functions I've never seen-- Otherworld tech is amazing! Mister Alk!!
lines.9: Yeah, it really is... Glad I brought you along.
lines.12: You've got quite the discerning eye. Then how about a weapon like this?
lines.16: --Alright, decided! I'll take every weapon on the shelf!!
lines.20: Whoa, whoa! Isn't that way too much!?
lines.24: It's all expenses, so no problem! Up-front investment is essential for inventing!
lines.29: That's way too muuuch!! Research costs, material costs, maintenance costs... You always spend like money grows on trees...!
lines.31: At least use standard-spec parts, or work it into a general-purpose design, think a little more about costs--
lines.35: Saving and compromising are nonsense! The ultimate cool only exists beyond relentless attention to detail!?
lines.39: That's exactly why heroes can trust their lives to gadgets, and why people go wild for them! That leads to commercial success too!
lines.44: Sigh... Honestly. The president's too soft...
lines.47: ...Well, building with limits is romantic too, isn't it? I cook that way sometimes.
lines.51: Hmm, so you're on that side, Mister Alk.
lines.54: ...I know, alright. But I have to prove it...
lines.58: --N-no, it's nothing. Just talking to myself.
lines.64: Dangerous driver on the highway. Handle it ASAP, please~.
lines.71: --Perfect timing. I just updated the bike. Let's take it for a test run!
lines.76: --You're not getting away! Mister Alk! Press the red button three times!
lines.83: Keeping up with this nitro plasma engine... Guess you've got some backbone.
lines.87: Of course! Hero Gadget No. 169 isn't just for show!!
lines.89: Equipped with 77 functions, including mini homing missiles, a water hover system, and an optical barrier! Unlike some ordinary machine--
lines.92: Hahaha!! "My super ultimate bike I made up," huh? Sounds like a kid's toy!
lines.99: Loading it up with useless junk. --I'll show you what it means to ride with everything else thrown away for speed.
lines.108: It's no good! Any more load and the reactor will explode!!
lines.112: But just watch...! My... our cool... will never lose...!!
lines.118: I brought a snack. You haven't eaten dinner, have you?
lines.122: ...Just leave it somewhere over there. I don't have time to rest. I have to prove--
lines.130: I have a brother five years older than me. When we were little, we'd pretend to be heroes and build our own gadgets... It was fun.
lines.133: ...But at some point, my brother threw away cool. He sold out to capitalism and became an efficiency freak.
lines.137: Efficiency freak... Hmm, but I see. So that's why you're so hung up on cool?
lines.141: I have to prove it. That our dream isn't something useless.
lines.145: No, that our cool is better than anything--!
lines.153: ...At the very least, there's no way a nitro plasma engine alone makes it that fast.
lines.156: He really did throw everything else away for speed. That bike was the definition of functional beauty.
lines.159: ...Why are you making that weird face?
lines.163: Nah, just... for someone you see as an enemy, you sure praise him accurately...
lines.168: W-well...! The technology isn't to blame...?
lines.172: ...I see. But then, wouldn't your efficiency-freak brother be functional beauty too...?
lines.180: No, but that's not it. I'm against people who deny romance... No, wait, wasn't I trying to deny that bike's romance too...?
lines.183: Alk, please answer me honestly. From where you're standing... do I have a brother complex...?
lines.188: Well, uh, hmm? ...Can I say no comment?
lines.197: Am I an idiot... Am I an idiot...? Why didn't I notice...
lines.200: The technology isn't to blame. There's as much romance as there are people. It's just a matter of taste...
lines.203: I don't want to beat anyone, and I don't want to deny anyone.
lines.205: I just love making things. I want to share that joy with everyone. ...That's all.
lines.209: There you go, you're back to your usual self~.
lines.214: Yeah, thanks. And that's exactly why... I need to make them understand my romance too!
lines.222: That bike is definitely the coolest. --But we won't lose either!
lines.225: Our ultimate cool and yours... Let's clash them all we want!!

3.title: Everyone's Own Cool
3.summary: At the suggestion of his brother, who has devoted himself to efficiency, Invetra goes up against him at Qualia TechCon, a showcase for companies' latest technology. Though he loses in the end, Invetra shows the audience his own path, and keeps moving forward so that his brother will acknowledge him someday.

lines.5: Hello, Gadget Channel! Today, believe it or not, we're livestreaming the debut of new gear straight from an incident scene!
lines.10: Is this the time to be streaming!? It's dangerous, get back!
lines.14: You don't get it, Ms. Nate. It's thrilling precisely because the developer himself puts his body on the line to explain it!
lines.17: --Now, Mister Alk! Gadget debut match, let's go!
lines.31: Invetra. Are you still wasting your life on that stuff? ...Wake up already.
lines.34: I believe in the cool we had back then. I'll chase it as far as it goes. That hasn't changed since those days.
lines.38: Brotherly squabbles are fine and all, but do you know where you are? This is PBC turf.
lines.40: Even if you're the security giant Megatro Techno-- Are you picking a fight?
lines.43: Yes, I am. ...You're watching, aren't you? Explain. King Johnson.
lines.46: Hello, hello! It's me! He made me a proposal a moment ago! It sounded fun, so I accepted!
lines.49: --Qualia TechCon. He wants a brotherly showdown on that stage.
lines.60: Qualia TechCon. An annual festival where companies show off their latest tech.
lines.65: Heh heh heh... I can't believe it. I actually get to take part in TechCon!
lines.69: You're way too carefree... A big corporation picked a fight with us and forced us into a competition, you know? We're being put on display.
lines.73: Being on display is fine! Whoever gets people talking wins! Is what the president would say. I agree with him.
lines.83: Ooh! Is that a sensory synchronization system? I never thought I'd see the real thing...! W-wait, let me touch it!
lines.88: --Well, it's a rare opportunity, right? Part of it is that whoever enjoys it most wins. Not that I'm Johnson or anything.
lines.92: Drag PBC's reputation into the dirt. Utterly. --Understood?
lines.94: You need to face reality too, Invetra. Just like I did...
lines.99: --And here we go! The tech competition that decides this year's top technology! First up is Megatro Techno!!
lines.103: Getting scored in front of a crowd... Ugh, just watching is giving me a stomachache.
lines.107: Invetra will be fine. --Oh, look. He's up next.
lines.111: --What do you think? The PBC Hero Development Division's gadgets are a cut above your everyday machines!
lines.114: This Kingfisher Device is a revolutionary combination of a matter-penetrating film and a pseudo-materialization system--
lines.117: Ahh, Mr. Invetra, was it? You stuffed in all the trendy latest tech. Well, of course it's amazing, then.
lines.119: Isn't that just wasteful? What's your sense of cost? Deadlines? Any prospects for mass production?
lines.125: Hmph, it's nothing but a hobby. This is a place for serious business. Toy shops should stay out.
lines.137: Sure, from where you're sitting, my inventions might be "toys". But isn't that important?
lines.141: Hero gadgets aren't mere tools. They're the symbols of heroes' justice. Proof of hope.
lines.144: It's because they shine flashy and dazzling that they strike someone's heart. That's why they can move people. Am I wrong?
lines.147: Look... That's just an excuse, isn't it? No thought for cost, no prospect of mass production, you can't call that a product--
lines.150: Of course, I accept that others disagree. Sophistication without waste, invisible efficiency, that's the coolest too.
lines.153: But what I love is "this". ...And I have friends who love it with me.
lines.156: People find dreams in what they admire. That's the kind of cool I'm aiming for.
lines.160: --So I'll keep moving forward! Toward the ultimate cool I believe in!
lines.168: So, in the end, the result's a loss? It's hard for our company to defend failing to deliver results, you know?
lines.172: Says the guy who knew about the buyout and left it alone~.
lines.177: I've been busy with my own seed-planting and groundwork for the future, you know? Couldn't you show me a little appreciation!?
lines.181: Well, at least it looks like there were results other than the ranking.
lines.184: Mr. Invetra, that was seriously moving! I became an engineer because of anime too...!
lines.186: Keep charging down that razor-sharp path! I intend to follow you to the ends of the earth!
lines.189: Heh, thank you. If you'd like, please subscribe to my channel and follow me on social--
lines.192: Don't get cocky. No matter how many hobby friends you gather, that means nothing--
lines.195: Just you wait, brother. Next time, I'll make you say my gadgets are cool.
lines.201: ...I'm not giving up. Apparently I've got a brother complex, after all.
lines.208: Building hijacking at a high-rise. Please deploy right away~!
lines.211: --Let's go, heroes! My gadgets are always on standby!!

1231099/1.19:
The PBC Hero Development Division's exclusive mechanic.
With eccentric ideas and solid mech-building skills,
he churns out one super gadget after another
for the heroes, though his fixation on details
is his one flaw.

5000234/2.19:
Invetra's modifications added 77 cutting-edge functions, including mini homing missiles, a water hover system, and an optical barrier.
But the excessive specs backfired, leaving it far behind its rival in top speed.

5000234/3.19:
After another tune-up, the machine was hailed as the coolest and fastest autonomous bike, combining romance and functional beauty.
But this time the modifications put speed and looks above all else, and it will be a little while before Invetra notices that other shortcomings, such as durability and equipment, still remain.

5000629/1.19:
Invetra's workplace, a department that researches and develops the gadgets carried by PBC's heroes day in and day out.
In its pursuit of romance, more than a few of its products have practical problems, but toy makers always respond enthusiastically, and countless of its designs have been turned into toys.

5000630/1.19:
Invetra's brother, five years his senior.
Like his younger brother, he is a skilled gadget developer, but unlike Invetra, who pursues romance and cool, he values efficiency and practicality.
He works for the security giant Megatro Techno.
